SM-2 arithmetic checked on real rows: Good keeps EF 2.5, Easy raises it to 2.6, both give a 1-day first interval; 'Again' (Takrorlash) re-queues to the TAIL and does not increment the studied count (walked the whole queue to confirm the card came back last). ORACLE (fixtures/uz-math-facts.md): all 12 backs correct, ZERO trap answers -- no hypotenuse 7, no D=b^2+4ac, no intersection {1,4}, no 'Pifagor discovered it first'; cards 3 and 10 solved independently (3-4-5; D=25-24=1, roots 2 and 3). Uzbek: Latin throughout, no ru/en leakage, consistent ASCII apostrophes, consistent terminology. F96 found + FIXED here (54e18ccf): a failed grade advanced the queue anyway. NOTE 2: a raw fetch from the browser without ?locale= returns {deck:null} because resolveLocale falls back to Accept-Language (en); that is the instrument, not a defect.

web:locale.content.id.podcast/INDIVIDUAL.tour_last: Oracle grading of the AI script + click-to-seek accuracy against the real audio timeline
web:locale.content.id.podcast/INDIVIDUAL.persona_last: B2C learner deciding whether they have time to listen
web:locale.content.id.podcast/INDIVIDUAL.notes: R2026-08-25d depth 3: played the uz episode, exercised all 12 transcript click-to-seek lines, and confirmed playback position persists across a real reload (resumed at 79s). ORACLE: the generated script scores 11/11 atomic claims against fixtures/uz-math-facts.md with ZERO trap answers (3-4-5 -> 5; 9+16=25; D=b^2-4ac not +4ac; x^2-5x+6=0 -> D=1, roots 2 and 3; A intersect B = {2,3} not {1,4}; katetlar 6/8 -> 10) and it explicitly says the theorem predates Pythagoras. Uzbek is clean: consistent U+2018 for o/g, U+2019 tutuq belgisi, no ru/en leakage. F102 (#50): the episode card shows 1:17 (a 150-wpm word-count estimate, generatePodcast.job.ts:135) while the player shows the real 1:31 -- two lengths for one episode on one screen. Click-to-seek was suspected next and is FINE: the stored segment timeline is 305840ms for a 91.75s file (TTS_BYTES_PER_MS=6 is Azure 48kbit/s, the provider is now OpenAI) but the client normalizes against the real duration, so all 12 seeks land monotonically 0 -> 87.19s, none past the end. Stale constant recorded on #50, not filed as a seek bug.

web:locale.quiz.id/INDIVIDUAL/uz-light-1.notes: R2026-08-25b depth 3 with a real oracle, not a rendering check. Pulled the source section body from the API and graded all 5 keys of the uz-math quiz against it and docs/qa/fixtures/uz-math-facts.md: 4 of 5 quote the source verbatim and are exact; none of the fixture's trap answers (hypotenuse 7, D = b^2+4ac, intersection {1,4}, "Pythagoras discovered it first") appears. Q1 is factually right but ungrounded and mis-cited -> O101. Metamorphic pair (tight): keyed answers -> score 100, garbage -> score 0. A defensible synonym for Q1 ("90 daraja") also scored 100, so the AI judge is doing its job rather than string-matching. In the browser: retook the quiz from scratch, answered all 5, submitted, and the 100% result survived a real location.reload(); mastery moved 62 -> 73 on the same screen. Input attacks on the answer field: empty keeps Tekshirish disabled; a `<script>` payload prefixed to a correct answer is escaped (no XSS, nothing raw in the DOM) and the judge accepted the answer while telling the student not to include the script part; a missing apostrophe ("to'gri") was tolerated. Residue: 4 extra attempts on this quiz for qa-individual.

web:locale.tenant.students/TENANT_OWNER/.tour_last: Input-attack matrix on the CSV import format + concurrent-import seat race
web:locale.tenant.students/TENANT_OWNER/.persona_last: Tutor importing a class roster out of Excel
web:locale.tenant.students/TENANT_OWNER/.notes: R2026-08-25c depth 3 (US-OWNER-23, the last untouched reach-list item): drove POST /tenant/students/import across 10 file shapes. F98/#48 -- a semicolon-delimited file (Excel's default in ru/uz Windows locales) imports its own header row as a student named 'name;email' and every data row as one whole-line name, HTTP 200, every row 'created', no warning field; same for comma files with non-English headers ('Ism' becomes a student). Reproduced twice, second time from restored state, with a headerless-positional control proving the behaviour is a deliberate feature the parser cannot distinguish from an unrecognised header. WORKING, do not re-test: leading UTF-8 BOM (String.trim() strips U+FEFF, so my 'BOM breaks the header' hypothesis was WRONG -- tested, refuted), CRLF, Cyrillic names, duplicate-in-one-file -> skipped_duplicate, formula-injection name stored raw on import (correct; escaping belongs on export and is already right). Seat race re-confirmed F87 (advisory GHSA-2r57-gmq8-w83r, NOT a new finding): 2 concurrent 13-row imports into 13 free seats -> 14 created, 26 active vs limit 25; each import refused 6 rows, so the per-row assert does fire and the overshoot here is +1, not unbounded -- appended to the advisory. Note the effective seat cap is subscription.limits.maxStudents (25), NOT Tenant.seatLimit (null). Test data: 27 probe students created across the cell, all deactivated; org restored to its original 5 active / 5 of 25 seats. Cell still carries F92/#44 (CLS 0.289) from the sweep.
